items.meta_title: VPN Server Locations: 16 Countries, 6 of Them Free | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Where VpnHood! CONNECT can connect from: Germany, France, the US, Canada, the UK and Poland on the free plan, ten more countries on Premium, and how to pick the right one.
items.title: Pick a country. Connect from there.
items.lead: Six of them are free, with no account to create. Premium opens every one of them, on faster servers, with five devices at a time.
items.grid_desc: Grouped by continent. Every free country is included in Premium as well, so the badges list every plan a country comes with.
items.pool_title: A location is a group of servers
items.pool_desc: Picking a country does not tie you to one machine. Every location here runs several servers, and the app chooses between them for you, going for the fastest one it can reach. You decide where to appear; it works out which server gets you there.
items.pick_desc: It depends on what you came for, and the two answers point in different directions.
items.pick_speed_desc: Every request travels to the server and back, so distance costs time on all of them. Pick the country closest to you, then test it properly instead of guessing.
items.pick_speed_link: How to test your VPN speed
items.pick_reach_title: For reach: the one where the content lives
items.pick_reach_desc: If a service only works from one country, that is the country to connect from. Split tunneling by country sends just that traffic through it and leaves the rest alone.
items.more_desc: We are working to cover the whole world, and new locations open where demand shows up. Requests are how we see it: tell us which country you need, and whether it is for speed or for reaching something specific, because that changes where the server should be.
items.note_ads: The free plan is funded by ads, so it is not available in China or in other countries where ads are not served. That is about where you are, not where the server is. Premium has no such limit.
